9:101:111.en: Categories of hypocrites and Commandment for the collection of Az-Zakah and Hypocrites' masjid for mischievous motives, called "Masjid-e-Zirar"

9:112:113.ar: اشترى الله من المؤمنين أنفسهم وأموالهم بالجنة
9:112:113.en: Allah has purchased the persons and wealth of the Believers in lieu of granting them the Paradise

9:114:117.en: Do not seek forgiveness for the Mushrikin

9:118:119.ar: توبة الله على الثلاثة الذين خُلّفوا لصدقهم
9:118:119.en: Allah forgave those three who lagged behind but were sincere

9:120:123.ar: المؤمنون يفضّلون الرسول على أنفسهم ووجوب التفقّه في الدين
9:120:123.en: Believers are those who prefer the life of the Rasool over their own and requirement of obtaining understanding of religion

9:124:128.en: Qur'anic verses do increase the faith of the believers

9:129:130.ar: أخلاق النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ودعاء علّمه الله
9:129:130.en: Character of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and Prayer taught by Allah

10:1:2.en: Al-Quran is the book of wisdom

10:3:5.ar: الله خالق الكون يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده
10:3:5.en: Allah is the One Who created this universe and He is the One Who originates the creation and repeats it

10:6:10.ar: آيات الله في خلق السماوات والأرض والشمس والقمر والليل والنهار
10:6:10.en: There are signs of His manifestation in the creation of heaven, earth, sun, moon, day and night

10:11:17.en: Behavior of the wrong doers towards Allah and His revelations

10:18:20.ar: الآلهة من دون الله لا تضرّ ولا تنفع وكان الناس أمة واحدة حتى اختلفوا
10:18:20.en: Deities other than Allah can neither harm nor benefit you and Mankind was one nation until they invented different creeds

10:21:23.ar: الناس يدعون الله في الشدة ويمكرون في الرخاء
10:21:23.en: Mankind call upon Allah in their sufferings but plot against Him in their happiness

10:25:30.ar: الله يدعو إلى دار السلام والآلهة المعبودة لا تعلم بعبادتهم
10:25:30.en: Allah invites you to the Home of Peace and Deities whom they worship are not even aware of their worship

10:31:36.en: Truth about Allah vs other gods invented by the Mushrikin

10:37:40.en: This Quran is the revelation of Allah

10:41:46.en: Those who disbelieve in this Quran shall be the losers in the hereafter

10:47:53.en: Every nation was sent a Rasool for their guidance

10:54:56.en: There shall be no way out for the unbelievers on the Day of Judgement

10:57:60.en: Al-Quran is a mercy, blessing, and cure for the problems of mankind

10:61:65.ar: الله شاهد على كل ما تفعلون
10:61:65.en: Whatever you do, Allah is a witness to it

10:66:70.ar: المشركون لا يتبعون إلا الظنّ ولا يدعون إلا الباطل
10:66:70.en: Mushrikin follow nothing but conjecture, preach nothing but falsehood

10:71:73.en: Story of Prophet Nuh and his people

10:74:82.ar: بعث الرسل إلى ذرّية نوح وإرسال موسى وهارون إلى فرعون
10:74:82.en: Rasools were sent to the descendants of Prophet Nuh - similarly Prophet Musa and Haroon were sent to Pharaoh

10:83:92.ar: قصة موسى وفرعون ونجاة بني إسرائيل من استعباد فرعون
10:83:92.en: Story of Musa and Fir'on (Pharaoh) and Children of Israel were delivered from the bondage of Fir'on

10:93:95.ar: إسكان الله بني إسرائيل مبوّأ صدق ورزقهم الطيبات
10:93:95.en: Children of Israel were provided with good dwellings and food

10:96:98.ar: الإيمان بعد معاينة العذاب لم ينفع أمة إلا قوم يونس
10:96:98.en: Belief after seeing the scourge did not benefit any nation except the nation of Yunus

10:99:103.ar: النهي عن إكراه الناس على الإسلام
10:99:103.en: Forcing someone to convert to Islam is prohibited

10:104:107.ar: لا يضرّ ولا ينفع إلا الله
10:104:107.en: No one other than Allah can harm or benefit you

10:108:109.ar: قل قد جاءكم الحق فمن اهتدى فلنفسه ومن ضل فعليها
10:108:109.en: Declare that guidance has come - now to follow or not to follow is your choice

11:6:8.en: Allah is the Sustainer of all creatures

11:9:14.ar: الإنسان جحود إلا المؤمنين والقرآن ليس مفترى من النبي
11:9:14.en: Mankind is ever ungrateful to Allah except the believers and Al-Quran is not forged by the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

11:15:24.ar: أهل الكتاب صنفان: من يرى الحق ومن يعرض عنه
11:15:24.en: People of the Book (Jews and Christians) are of two kinds, those who can see the Truth, and those who choose not to

11:25:35.ar: دعوة نوح لقومه وتحدّيهم له بعذاب الله
11:25:35.en: Nuh's address to his people and Nuh's people challenged him and asked for the scourge of Allah

11:36:39.en: Allah commanded Nuh to build and ark

11:40:41.ar: أمر الله نوحًا بالركوب وحمل المؤمنين وزوجين من كل نوع
11:40:41.en: Allah commanded Nuh to embark and gather on board the believers and a pair from every species

11:42:49.en: Dialogue between Nuh, his son, and Allah

11:50:59.en: Prophet Hud's address to his people, their disbelief and its consequences

11:60:67.en: Prophet Salah's address to his people, their disbelief and its consequences

11:68:75.ar: بشرى إبراهيم بابن هو إسحاق ومن ورائه يعقوب
11:68:75.en: Good news for Prophet Ibrahim, he will have a son (Isaac) and beyond him a grandson (Jacob)

11:76:82.en: Prophet Lut's address to his people, their disbelief and its consequences

11:83:95.ar: دعوة شعيب لقومه الذين يغشّون في معاملاتهم وكفرهم وعاقبته
11:83:95.en: Prophet Shu'aib's address to his people who were cheating in their business transactions and Their disbelief and its consequences

11:96:109.ar: مصير فرعون وملئه الذين حُذّروا فلم يستجيبوا
11:96:109.en: Fate of Fir'on and his chiefs who were warned but they gave no heed

11:110:113.ar: اختلاف الناس في التوراة التي أُعطيها موسى
11:110:113.en: Differences arose about Torah given to Musa for his followers' lack of belief

11:114:117.ar: الحسنات يذهبن السيئات والله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين
11:114:117.en: Virtues remove evils, Allah does not let the reward of the righteous be wasted

11:118:121.en: Freedom of choice given to mankind is the Will of Allah

12:1:3.en: Al-Quran is revealed in the Arabic language

12:7:10.en: There are lessons in this story for the inquirers

12:11:15.ar: طلب إخوة يوسف من أبيهم إرساله معهم وإلقاؤه في البئر
12:11:15.en: Stepbrothers of Yusuf asked their father to send him with them on a hunting trip and threw him in a dark well

12:16:18.ar: ادّعاؤهم لأبيهم أن الذئب أكل يوسف
12:16:18.en: They told their father that Yusuf was eaten by a wolf

12:19:20.ar: التقطته قافلة وأُخذ إلى مصر وبيع
12:19:20.en: One caravan kidnapped him, brought him to Egypt, and sold him

12:21:22.ar: العزيز الذي اشتراه كان رجلًا كريمًا
12:21:22.en: The Egyptian who bought him was a nice man

12:23:29.ar: مراودة امرأة العزيز له وعصمة الله ليوسف
12:23:29.en: His master's wife tried to seduce him but Allah saved him

12:30:35.ar: لوم نساء المدينة لها ودعوتها لهنّ ثم سجن يوسف
12:30:35.en: Women of the town started pointing fingers at her, she invited them to a banquet and asked Yusuf to appear before them and Yusuf was sent to prison

12:36:42.ar: رؤيا صاحبي السجن وتأويل يوسف ودعوته لهما
12:36:42.en: Two prison inmates had dreams and asked Yusuf for interpretation and Yusuf's address to his fellow inmates

12:43:49.ar: رؤيا ملك مصر وتأويل يوسف لها
12:43:49.en: King of Egypt had a dream and asked for its interpretation and Yusuf's interpretation of the King's dream

12:50:52.ar: ملك مصر ينظر في قضية يوسف ويقرّ ببراءته
12:50:52.en: King of Egypt heard the case of Yusuf and declared him innocent

12:53:57.en: Yusuf's appointment as King's cabinet member

12:58:62.ar: مجيء إخوة يوسف إلى مصر لطلب الطعام وأمر يوسف لهم بإحضار أخيهم بنيامين
12:58:62.en: Yusuf's brothers came to Egypt to get food and grain and Yusuf asked them to bring Benjamin (Yusuf's younger brother)

12:63:68.ar: طلبهم من أبيهم إرسال بنيامين معهم ووصية يعقوب لبنيه
12:63:68.en: They asked their father to send Benjamin with them in order to get more grain and Ya'qoob's advice to his sons

12:69:79.ar: تعريف يوسف بنفسه لأخيه وتدبيره إبقاءه واتهام بنيامين بالسرقة
12:69:79.en: Yusuf introduced himself to his brother and plotted to retain him and Benjamin was accused of stealing so that he could be retained

12:80:87.ar: عودة إخوة يوسف وإخبارهم أباهم بسرقة بنيامين وإبقائه وإرسال أبيهم لهم مرة أخرى
12:80:87.en: Yusuf's brothers went back and told their father about the incident of Benjamin's stealing and retention and Their father sent them back

12:88:93.ar: مجيئهم إلى يوسف وطلبهم الطعام والصدقة وكشف يوسف عن نفسه وعفوه عنهم واستدعاء أهله
12:88:93.en: They came to Yusuf and begged for food and some charity and Yusuf disclosed his identity and He forgave his brothers and sent for his family

12:94:98.en: Ya'qoob got the good news of his son Yusuf

12:99:104.ar: انتقال الأسرة من كنعان إلى مصر ودعاء يوسف أن يتوفاه الله مسلمًا
12:99:104.en: Thus his family relocated from Ken'and to Egypt and Yusuf's prayer to live and die as a Muslim

12:105:108.en: Most of the ignorant people who believe in Allah also commit shirk

12:109:111.ar: كل الرسل بشر وقصة يوسف تصديق لما سبق من الكتب
12:109:111.en: All Rasools were human beings and Story of Yusuf is confirmation of previous scriptures

13:1:3.ar: القرآن منزّل من خالق السماوات والأرض
13:1:3.en: Al-Quran is revealed by Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth

13:4:8.ar: الأشجار والثمار والخضروات وطعومها آيات من الله ولكل قوم هاد
13:4:8.en: Trees, fruit, vegetables and their tastes are the signs of Allah and For every nation Allah sent a guide (Rasool)

13:9:17.ar: الله لا يغيّر ما بقوم حتى يغيّروا ما بأنفسهم والدعاء لله وحده
13:9:17.en: Allah never changes the condition of a people unless they want to change themselves and Pray to Allah alone

13:18:20.ar: الآلهة من دون الله لا تملك ضرًّا ولا نفعًا ومن لم يستجب لربه فلا نجاة له
13:18:20.en: Deities besides Allah have no control over any harm or benefit and Those who do not respond to the call of their Rabb will have escape

13:21:27.ar: من وفّى بعهد الله فله عقبى الدار ومن نقضه فله اللعنة وسوء الدار
13:21:27.en: Those who fulfil their pledge with Allah will have and excellent home in the hereafter and Those who break their pledge will have the curse and a terrible home

13:28:30.en: It is the remembrance of Allah that provides tranquility to hearts

13:31:32.ar: لا إله إلا هو وكل شيء بأمره
13:31:32.en: There is no God but Him, all things are subject to His command

13:33:35.en: Allah watches minutely each and every soul

13:36:38.ar: القرآن نزل بلسان عربي ليسهل فهمه
13:36:38.en: Al-Quran is revealed in Arabic for easy understanding

13:39:44.ar: الرسول لا يأتي بمعجزة إلا بإذن الله ولا معقّب لحكمه والله صاحب المكر كله
13:39:44.en: Rasool has no power to show any miracle without the sanction of Allah and When Allah commands, there is none to reverse it and That Allah is the Master of all planning

14:2:4.ar: هذا الكتاب نزل ليخرج الناس من الظلمات إلى النور
14:2:4.en: This Book is revealed to bring the mankind out from darkness into light

14:5:6.en: All Rasools speak the language of their own people

14:7:8.ar: بعث موسى ليخرج قومه من الظلمات إلى النور
14:7:8.en: Prophet Musa was sent to lead his people out from darkness into light

14:9:15.ar: لو كفر أهل الأرض جميعًا فلا يضرّ ذلك الله وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
14:9:15.en: If all the dwellers of earth become nonbelievers, it makes no difference to Allah and In Allah let the believers put their trust

14:16:20.ar: الله يعاقب الظالمين ويكرم من خاف مقامه
14:16:20.en: Allah punishes the wrongdoers and blesses those who dread His eminence

14:21:23.en: Allah has based the creation of the heavens and the earth on Truth

14:24:24.ar: لا سلطان للشيطان على الإنسان، إنما يدعو فيستجيب الناس
14:24:24.en: Shaitan has no power over human beings - he only invites and people follow

14:26:29.en: Example of a "good word" and a "bad word"

14:30:36.ar: من جحد نعم الله يُلقى في جهنم ونِعَم الله لا تُحصى
14:30:36.en: Those who show ingratitude towards Allah's favors shall be cast into Hell and Allah has given you countless favors

14:37:43.ar: دعاء إبراهيم لمكة وأهلها ودعاؤه الذي صار جزءًا من الصلوات الخمس
14:37:43.en: The prayer of Prophet Ibrahim for the city of Mecca and its residents and The prayer of Prophet Ibrahim which is made a part of five daily prayers

14:44:53.ar: لا تظنّ أن الله غافل عن الظالمين ولا أنه يخلف وعده رسله
14:44:53.en: Never think that Allah is unaware of the unjust, or that He will ever break His promise made to His Rasools

14:54:54.ar: الله إله واحد لا شريك له
14:54:54.en: Allah is the One and Only God

15:2:15.ar: يتمنى الكافرون يوم القيامة لو كانوا مسلمين وتكفّل الله بحفظ القرآن
15:2:15.en: On the Day of Judgement, the unbelievers will wish that they were Muslims and Allah Himself has taken the responsibility of preserving Al-Quran

15:16:25.ar: خلق الله السماء وزيّنها وخلق في الأرض كل ما يصلح لحياة الإنسان
15:16:25.en: Allah created and decorated the heavens and also created everything suitable for human life on earth

15:26:44.ar: قصة خلق آدم وسجود الملائكة له وإباء إبليس ومصير الشيطان وأتباعه جهنم
15:26:44.en: Story of Adam's creation; prostration of the angels before him and the refusal of Shaitan to prostrate and Shaitan and his followers are destined for hell

15:45:50.en: The righteous will be awarded paradise

15:51:60.en: Prophet Ibrahim is given the good news of a son by two angels

15:61:79.ar: مجيء الملائكة إلى لوط وتنفيذ أمر الله بإهلاك قوم لوط بالحجارة
15:61:79.en: The same angels came to Prophet Lut and executed Allah's decree of stoning to death the nation of homosexuals

15:80:86.en: Punishment to the people of Hijr for their disbelief

15:87:99.ar: الفاتحة هي السبع المثاني والأمر بالجهر بما أُمر به والإعراض عن المشركين
15:87:99.en: Al-Fatiha is also called, "Seven verses worthy of oft-recitation" And Proclaim the commandments of Allah publicly and turn away from the Mushrikin

16:1:9.ar: أنزل الله وحيه لينذر أنه لا إله إلا هو وخلق الأنعام لمنفعة الناس
16:1:9.en: Allah has sent down His revelations to warn that there is no god but Him and He has created cattle for the benefit of human beings

16:10:21.ar: الله ينزل الماء من السماء للشرب والزرع وجعل الجبال رواسي ونِعَمه لا تُحصى
16:10:21.en: It is He Who sends down water from the sky for drinking and agriculture and He set mountains to stabilize earth and Allah has bestowed so many favors that you cannot even count them

16:22:25.en: Unbelievers are arrogant and they will be held responsible for that attitude

16:26:34.ar: يخزي الله المستكبرين يوم القيامة ويدخلهم النار وللمتقين الجنة
16:26:34.en: On the Day of Judgement Allah will humiliate the arrogant and cast them into hell, while the righteous will be awarded paradise

16:35:40.ar: بعث الله الرسل لتحذير الكافرين الذين يقولون لو شاء الله ما عبدنا غيره
16:35:40.en: Allah has sent the Rasools to warn against the unbelievers excuse, "If Allah wanted, we would have not worshipped anyone else"

16:41:44.ar: وعد الله المهاجرين في سبيله بدار حسنة
16:41:44.en: Allah has promised a good abode for those who migrate for His sake

16:45:50.en: Do the unbelievers feel secure against the wrath of Allah

16:51:60.ar: إذا مسّ الكافرين الضرّ دعوا الله وحده فإذا كشفه عنهم أشركوا
16:51:60.en: Whenever unbelievers are in distress they call upon Allah alone; no sooner does He relieve them that they start committing shirk

16:61:65.ar: لو يؤاخذ الله الناس بظلمهم ما ترك عليها من دابة والقرآن يحيي النفوس كما يحيي الماء الأرض الميتة
16:61:65.en: If Allah were to punish for wrong doings, He would not leave even and animal around the wrongdoers and As water gives life to dead land so does Al-Quran to the human soul

16:66:70.ar: في الأنعام التي تُنتج اللبن وفي النحل عبرة للناس
16:66:70.en: There is a lesson for mankind in the lives of animals ie, milk-producing animals and the honeybee

16:71:76.ar: في خلقكم عبرة فلماذا تؤمنون بآلهة لا تخلق شيئًا وتكفرون بالله الخالق؟
16:71:76.en: There is a lesson in the process of your own creation; Why then, believe in deities who have no power to create anything and disbelieve in Allah, the Creator

16:77:83.ar: في الطير والحيوان آيات من آيات الله
16:77:83.en: There are also signs of Allah in the lives of the birds and the animals

16:84:89.ar: يوم القيامة يُبعث من كل أمة شهيد ويواجه الكافرون حقيقة آلهتهم المزعومة
16:84:89.en: On the Day of Judgement a witness will be called from each nation and the unbelievers will face the reality of their invented false gods

16:90:94.ar: أمر الله بالعدل والإحسان وإيتاء ذي القربى ونهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والبغي
16:90:94.en: Allah commands to do justice, do good to others, and give to near relatives; and He forbids indecency, wickedness, and rebellion

16:95:100.ar: ما عندكم ينفد وما عند الله باقٍ والاستعاذة بالله من الشيطان عند قراءة القرآن
16:95:100.en: What is with you is transitory; and what is with Allah is everlasting and When you recite Al-Quran, seek Allah's protection against Shaitan

16:101:110.ar: اتهام الكافرين لمحمد بأن بشرًا يعلّمه القرآن، واللسان الذي يلحدون إليه أعجمي وهذا لسان عربي مبين
16:101:110.en: Unbelievers accused Muhammad (pbuh) of being taught Al-Quran by a certain man, but the man they allude to is non-Arab while Al-Quran is in eloquent Arabic

16:111:119.ar: لا تقولوا بألسنتكم هذا حلال وهذا حرام، فالحلال والحرام من عند الله
16:111:119.en: Do not declare with your tongue what is Halal (lawful) and what is Haram (unlawful) - Halal and Haram are from Allah

16:120:124.en: Ibrahim was a nation in himself

16:125:128.ar: الدعوة إلى سبيل الله بالحكمة والموعظة الحسنة والجدال بالتي هي أحسن
16:125:128.en: Call towards the Way of Allah with wisdom; advise and reason in a courteous manner

17:1:1.ar: إسراء الله بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
17:1:1.en: Allah took Muhammad (pbuh) on a tour of the universe

17:2:10.ar: تحقّق ما في كتاب بني إسرائيل من إفسادهم في الأرض مرتين وعقوبتهم في كل مرة والقرآن يهدي للتي هي أقوم
17:2:10.en: Allah fulfilled the prophecy made in the Holy Book of the Israelites that they will create mischief in the land twice and each time they will be punished and Al-Quran guides to the perfectly Straight Way

17:11:14.ar: يُعطى كل إنسان كتاب أعماله يوم القيامة
17:11:14.en: The book of his own deeds shall be given to each individual on the Day of Judgement

17:15:17.ar: من اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه ومن ضلّ فإنما يضلّ عليها
17:15:17.en: He that seeks guidance does so to his own good and he who goes astray does so to his own loss

17:18:22.ar: من أراد العاجلة عُجّل له فيها ثم يُصلى جهنم في الآخرة
17:18:22.en: He that desires the transitory things of this life is given here, but in the hereafter he shall be condemned to hell

17:23:30.ar: وصايا من الله للمؤمنين منها الإحسان إلى الوالدين والأقارب والمجتمع
17:23:30.en: Some commandments of Allah for the believers including proper behavior with parents, relatives, and the community at large

17:41:44.ar: لو كان معه آلهة لابتغوا إلى ذي العرش سبيلًا
17:41:44.en: If there were other gods besides Allah, they would have tried to dethrone Him

17:45:52.ar: الإيمان بالآخرة ضروري لفهم القرآن والآخرة هي الحياة بعد الموت
17:45:52.en: Belief in the hereafter is necessary to understand Al-Quran and Hereafter is Life after death

17:53:55.ar: على المؤمنين أن يقولوا الكلمة الطيبة فقط
17:53:55.en: Believers should speak only good words

17:56:57.ar: الآلهة المزعومة لا تملك كشف الضرّ عنكم
17:56:57.en: Invented gods have no power to relieve you from any distress

17:58:60.ar: لماذا لم تُرسل الآيات إلى محمد كما أُرسلت إلى الأنبياء قبله؟
17:58:60.en: Why the signs are not sent to Muhammad (pbuh) like prior prophets

17:61:65.ar: عداوة الشيطان للإنسان وعزمه على إغوائه
17:61:65.en: Shaitan, his enmity with human beings, and his vow to seduce them

17:66:70.ar: سخّر الله لكم ما تركبون في البرّ والبحر
17:66:70.en: Allah has provided conveyance for you on land and sea

17:71:72.en: Accountability of every community and its leaders

17:73:77.ar: لا مساومة في أحكام الإسلام ومبادئه
17:73:77.en: No compromise is allowed in matters of Islamic law and principles

17:78:84.ar: الصلوات الخمس وتهجّد النبي والقرآن شفاء ورحمة للمؤمنين
17:78:84.en: Five times daily Salah (prayers) and and extra prayer called Tahajjud for the Holy Prophet and Al-Quran is a healing and mercy for the believers

17:85:88.ar: الروح من أمر ربي ولا يأتي أحد بمثل هذا القرآن
17:85:88.en: Ar-Ruh (Spirit) is at the command of Allah and No one can produce a Quran like this

17:89:93.ar: تنويع الله في القرآن أساليب البيان ليفهم الناس رسالته
17:89:93.en: In Al-Quran Allah has used different methods to make people understand His Message

17:94:100.ar: أرسل الله إلى البشر رسولًا بشرًا ولو كان في الأرض ملائكة لأرسل ملَكًا رسولًا، ولا يشكّ في البعث إلا الكافرون
17:94:100.en: Allah has sent a human Rasool to human beings; if the dwellers of earth had been Angels, Allah would have sent and angel as a Rasool and Only disbelievers can doubt life after death

17:101:104.ar: أُعطي موسى تسع آيات ومع ذلك لم يؤمن به الناس
17:101:104.en: Musa was given NINE signs; people still did not believe him

17:105:110.ar: القرآن نزل بالحق منجّمًا ليُقرأ على مُكث، والأمر بالتوسّط في الصلاة فلا جهر ولا إخفات
17:105:110.en: Al-Quran is revealed in truth and with the truth it has come dow in sections to suit each occasion, for easy deliberation Offer Salah neither too loud nor too low a voice, adopt the middle course

18:1:6.ar: من قال إن لله ولدًا فقد قال قولًا عظيمًا
18:1:6.en: Those who say Allah has begotten a son are uttering a monstrous lie

18:7:12.en: Story of the Companions of the Cave

18:13:17.ar: فتية آمنوا بالتوحيد ففرّوا ولجأوا إلى الكهف
18:13:17.en: They were young men who declared the truth about the Oneness of Allah and They had to run away and take refuge in a cave

18:18:20.ar: ناموا ثم أيقظهم الله بعد مئات السنين
18:18:20.en: They are in a state of sleep and They were waken up by Allah after hundreds of year

18:21:23.ar: كشف أمرهم لحسم الخلاف في البعث، وبدل أن يفهموا العبرة انشغلوا بعددهم
18:21:23.en: Their identity was disclosed to resolve the disputed issue of life after death, What a shame that instead of getting the point people are disputing about their numbers

18:24:26.ar: إذا وعدت بفعل شيء في المستقبل فقل إن شاء الله
18:24:26.en: Whenever you promise to do something in future, always say, "Insha Allah (If Allah wills)"

18:27:31.ar: لا يملك أحد تبديل كلمات الله وقل: الحق من ربكم فمن شاء فليؤمن ومن شاء فليكفر
18:27:31.en: No one is authorized to change the Word of Allah and Proclaim, "Truth from Allah has come, choice is yours, believe or disbelieve"

18:32:43.en: Parable of a believer and a disbeliever

18:44:48.en: Similitude of worldly life and its relationship with the life of hereafter

18:49:52.en: Fate of those who follow the Shaitan and commit shirk

18:53:58.ar: ضرب الله للناس في القرآن من كل مثل ليفهموا رسالته
18:53:58.en: Allah has given all kinds of examples in the Quran, so that the people may understand His Message

18:59:69.ar: سفر موسى لطلب العلم عند الخضر وتحذير الخضر له بأنه لن يستطيع الصبر معه
18:59:69.en: Prophet Musa travelled to find Khizer to learn some of the knowledge given to him by Allah Almighty and Khizer warned Musa that he would not be able to bear with him

18:70:73.ar: لم يستطع موسى الصبر عن السؤال حين خرق الخضر السفينة وحين قتل الغلام
18:70:73.en: Prophet Musa could not resist questioning Khizer when he made a hole in boat, and when he killed a boy with no apparent reason

18:74:81.en: Story of Prophet Musa and Khizer

18:98:103.en: Fate of the Mushrikin and the Believers on the Day of Judgement

18:104:104.ar: كلمات الله لا تنفد ولا تُحصى
18:104:104.en: Words of Allah are countless and can not be recorded

18:105:105.en: Muhammad is but a human being like you

19:1:14.en: The story of Zakariya and the birth and youth of Yahya (John)

19:15:25.en: The story of Maryem and the miraculous birth of Isa (Jesus)

19:26:33.ar: جاءت مريم بابنها إلى قومها فتكلّم في المهد دفاعًا عن أمّه وإعلانًا لنبوّته
19:26:33.en: Maryem brought her baby (Jesus) to her people, and the baby spoke to his people in the cradle to defend his mother and proclaim his assignment to be their Prophet

19:34:40.ar: عيسى ليس ابن الله، ولا يليق بجلال الله أن يتخذ ولدًا
19:34:40.en: Isa (Jesus) is not the son of God, it is not befitting to the Majesty of God that He needs to beget a son for name, fame, help or continuity of race

19:41:50.en: Story of Ibrahim and his idol worshipping father

19:51:57.en: Prophethood of Musa, Isma`il and Idris

19:58:65.en: All prophets of Allah were Divine Guided and chosen

19:66:83.ar: حياة المؤمنين والكافرين في الدنيا وحياتهم في الآخرة
19:66:83.en: Believers and unbelievers' life in this world and their life in the Hereafter

19:84:99.ar: لا إله غير الله ينقذكم يوم القيامة، ومن قال اتخذ الله ولدًا فقد جاء بقول تكاد السماوات تتفطّر منه، والله يسّر القرآن
19:84:99.en: No god other than Allah will be able to save you on the Day of Judgement and Those who say Allah has begotten as son preach such a monstrous lie that even the heavens may crack, earth split and mountains crumble to pieces and Allah has made the Quran easy for Mankind

20:1:7.ar: القرآن تذكرة لمن يخشى، تنزيل ممن خلق الأرض والسماوات
20:1:7.en: Al-Quran is a reminder for those who fear Allah, the Creator of the heavens and earth

20:8:15.ar: ذهاب موسى إلى الوادي المقدس طوى عند جبل الطور
20:8:15.en: Prophet Musa went to the sacred valley of 'Tuwa' at mount Tur

20:16:23.ar: اصطفاء الله لموسى رسولًا وإرساله إلى فرعون
20:16:23.en: Allah chose him as His Rasool and assigned him towards Fir'on (Pharaoh)

20:24:47.ar: دعاء موسى بشرح صدره وتيسير أمره وحلّ عقدة لسانه، فاستجاب الله له وذكّره بنعمه
20:24:47.en: Prophet Musa prayed to Allah to open his heart, easy his task and remove the impediment from his speech so that people may understand, what he says Allah granted his request and reminded him about His favors

20:55:63.ar: كذّب فرعون موسى واعتبر معجزاته سحرًا وتحدّاه أن يواجه سحرته علنًا فقبل موسى التحدي
20:55:63.en: Fir'on disbelieved Musa by calling his miracles a magician trick and challenged him to confront his magicians in public - Musa accepted the challenge

20:64:75.ar: مواجهة موسى لسحرة فرعون وإسلام السحرة بعد معاينة المعجزة وحوارهم مع فرعون
20:64:75.en: Confrontation of Musa and Fir'on's magicians, after witnessing Musa's miracle Magicians accepted Islam and Dialogue between Magicians and Fir'on

20:76:80.ar: نجاة بني إسرائيل من استعباد فرعون
20:76:80.en: Deliverance of the Children of Israel from the bondage of Fir'on

20:81:88.ar: ذهاب موسى إلى الطور لمناجاة ربه وعبادة بني إسرائيل للعجل في غيابه
20:81:88.en: When Prophet Musa went to Mount Tur for communion with Allah - Israelites started worshipping calf in his absence

20:89:96.ar: سؤال موسى عن عبادة الأصنام وموقفه من السامري والعجل الذهبي وخطابه لقومه
20:89:96.en: Musa's inquiry about the idol worshipping, his decision about Samiri, Golden Calf and his address to his people

20:97:102.ar: القرآن تذكرة والحياة الدنيا تبدو في الآخرة يومًا واحدًا
20:97:102.en: AL-Quran is but a reminder and the life of this world shall appears to be no longer than one day in the Hereafter

20:103:109.en: A scene from the Day of judgement

20:110:112.ar: نزل القرآن عربيًّا للتعليم والتذكير فاقرأ وقل: ربّ زدني علمًا
20:110:112.en: AL-Quran is sent in Arabic to teach and to remind, so read and say, "O Rabb increase my Knowledge"

20:113:126.ar: قصة خلق آدم وإغواء الشيطان وعفو الله عنه وهدايته، ومن أعرض عن القرآن يُحشر أعمى يوم القيامة
20:113:126.en: Story of Adam's creation and Shaitan's temptation and Allah forgave Adam's sin, chose him and guided him to the right Way and Those who do not read AL-Quran and follow its guidance shall be raise as blind on the Day of Resurrection

20:127:131.ar: لا تحسدوا الناس على متاع الدنيا بل اطلبوا رضا الله لتنالوا العاقبة الحسنى
20:127:131.en: Do not envy others in worldly benefits, rather seek Allah's pleasure if you want to attain the blessed end

20:132:134.ar: القرآن آية من الله فلا عذر للكافرين يوم القيامة
20:132:134.en: AL-Quran is a sign from Allah so there can be no excuse for the unbelievers on the Day of Judgement

21:1:10.ar: اقترب الحساب والكافرون غافلون عن الإنذار يجادلون كيف يكون الرسول بشرًا
21:1:10.en: The day of accountability is getting closer but the disbelievers are still heedless to the admonition and disputing as to how Rasool can be a human beings

21:11:15.ar: أُهلكت الأمم السابقة بمثل هذه الذنوب
21:11:15.en: Prior nations were destroyed due to similar iniquities

21:16:18.en: The creation of heavens and earth is not a game

21:19:24.ar: لو كان فيهما آلهة غير الله لفسدتا
21:19:24.en: If there were more than One God, the heavens and earth would have been in a state of disorder

21:25:29.ar: كل الرسل بُعثوا برسالة واحدة: لا إله إلا الله فاعبدوه وحده
21:25:29.en: All Rasools were sent with the same Message, "There is no god but Allah, so worship Him alone

21:30:33.ar: كانت السماوات والأرض رتقًا ففتقهما الله وخلق من الماء كل شيء حي
21:30:33.en: The skies and earth once were once one mass, Allah split them asunder, and He created all living things from water

21:34:41.ar: لم يجعل الله الخلود لأي بشر، فإذا كان الرسل يموتون فكيف يخلد الكافرون؟
21:34:41.en: Allah has not granted immortality to any human being If Rasools are destined to die, how disbelievers are going to live for ever!

21:42:47.ar: الآلهة المزعومة لا تدافع عن نفسها فكيف تدافع عنهم، وتُنصب الموازين يوم القيامة
21:42:47.en: Invented gods can not even defend themselves, how they will defend them against Allah and Scale of justice shall be set up on the Day of Judgement

21:48:50.ar: أُعطي موسى الفرقان وهذا القرآن كذلك
21:48:50.en: Musa was given AL-Furqan (the criterion of right and wrong), so is this AL-Quran

21:51:70.ar: إبراهيم يناقش أباه وقومه في عبادة الأصنام ثم يحطّمها ليبيّن أن ما لا يدافع عن نفسه لا ينفعهم، فأرادوا حرقه فجعل الله النار بردًا وسلامًا عليه
21:51:70.en: Ibrahim questioned the idol worshiping of his father and his people and Ibrahim broke all their idols to show, that the gods who can not even defend themselves, how they can be of any benefit to them and They decided to burn him alive but Allah commanded the fire to be cool and comfortable for Ibrahim

21:71:74.ar: وهب الله لإبراهيم إسحاق ثم يعقوب وجعلهما نبيَّين
21:71:74.en: Allah blessed Ibrahim with son (Ishaq) and then a grandson (Ya'qoob) and made each of them Prophets

21:75:76.ar: استجابة الله لدعاء نوح على الكافرين
21:75:76.en: Allah accepted the prayer of Nuh against the unbelievers

21:77:81.ar: آتى الله داود وسليمان حكمًا وعلمًا وملكًا
21:77:81.en: Allah blessed Prophets Dawood and Sulaiman with wisdom, knowledge and kingdoms

21:82:83.ar: استجابة الله لدعاء أيوب وكشف ضرّه
21:82:83.en: Allah accepted Prophet Ayub's prayer and removed his affliction

21:84:90.ar: استجابة الله لدعاء إسماعيل وذي الكفل ويونس وزكريا وإنعامه على مريم
21:84:90.en: Allah accepted the prayers and blessed Prophets Isma`il, Zulkifl, Yunus, Zakariya and also blessed Maryem

21:93:96.ar: من عمل صالحًا وهو مؤمن فلا كفران لسعيه
21:93:96.en: Whoever does good deeds, provided he is a believer, his endeavor will not be rejected

21:97:105.en: The Day of Judgement and the fate of the disbelievers and the believers

21:106:111.en: Allah has sent Muhammad (pbuh) as a blessing for all the worlds (Humans, Jinns and others)

22:1:4.en: A scene from the Hour of Doom

22:5:7.en: Life cycle, life in this world and the life in the Hereafter

22:8:10.ar: يعبد الناس آلهة من دون الله بغير علم ولا هدى
22:8:10.en: People invoke other deities besides Allah, without knowledge and guidance

22:11:14.ar: حال من يعبد الله على حرف
22:11:14.en: Behavior of those who are standing at the verge of faith

22:15:18.ar: الله ينصر رسله ويسجد له من في السماوات والأرض
22:15:18.en: Allah always help His Rasools and All the dwellers of the heavens and the earth prostrate before Allah

22:19:20.ar: للكافرين ثياب من نار وحميم ومقامع من حديد
22:19:20.en: Disbelievers will have garment of fire, boiling water and maces of iron to lash them with

22:21:23.ar: سوّى الله بين المؤمنين في المسجد الحرام سواء المقيم والبادي
22:21:23.en: Allah has given equal rights to all believers for Masjid-al-Haram whether they are natives or foreigners

22:24:28.ar: بوّأ الله إبراهيم مكان البيت وأمره ببناء الكعبة ثم الأذان في الناس بالحج
22:24:28.en: Allah identified the sight of Sacred House to Ibrahim, commanded him to built Ka'bah then call mankind to come for Hajj (Pilgrimage)

22:29:31.ar: من أشرك بالله فكأنما خرّ من السماء فتخطفه الطير
22:29:31.en: Committing shirk is as though he had fallen from the sky and his body is snatched away by the birds

22:32:36.ar: لن ينال الله لحومها ولا دماؤها ولكن يناله التقوى منكم
22:32:36.en: It is not the meat or the blood of the sacrificed animals that reaches Allah, it is your piety that reaches Him

22:37:39.ar: الإذن للمؤمنين بالقتال دفاعًا عن النفس وفي سبيل الله
22:37:39.en: Permission is granted to the believers to fight in self defence, and for the cause of Allah

22:40:43.ar: يا محمد لست وحدك المكذَّب فقد كُذّب الأنبياء من قبلك
22:40:43.en: O Muhammad, "you are not the only one being denied, all Prophets were denied before you"

22:44:46.ar: يوم عند ربك كألف سنة مما تعدّون
22:44:46.en: A day of your Rabb is equal to one thousand year of your calculation

22:47:49.en: Acceptors of Truth shall be forgiven, while others punished

22:50:55.ar: الشيطان يلقي في أمنية كل رسول فينسخ الله ما يلقي، وفي يوم القيامة الله وحده هو الحَكَم
22:50:55.en: Shaitan tempered with the wishes of all Rasools but Allah abrogated such interjection and On the Day of Judgement Allah Himself shall be the Judge for all

22:56:62.ar: من هاجر في سبيل الله يُرزق رزقًا حسنًا والله هو الحق وكل ما سواه باطل
22:56:62.en: Those who migrated for the sake of Allah shall be generously rewarded and Allah is the only One who is real, all other deities are false

22:63:65.ar: الله الذي أحياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ليحكم بينكم
22:63:65.en: Allah is the One Who has given you life, cause you to die and will bring you back to life for passing on His Judgement

22:66:70.ar: الله يحكم بينكم فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
22:66:70.en: Allah will Judge between you concerning those matter in which you differ

22:71:72.ar: الآلهة من دون الله لا تقدر على خلق ذبابة
22:71:72.en: Gods besides Allah has no power to create even a creature like fly

22:73:76.ar: سمّى الله المؤمنين مسلمين في الكتب السابقة وفي هذا القرآن
22:73:76.en: Allah named the believers as Muslims in the prior Scriptures and also in this (AL-Quran)

23:17:22.ar: خلق الله السماوات والنبات والأشجار والأنعام لمنفعة الإنسان
23:17:22.en: Allah has made the heavens, vegetation, trees and Animals for the benefit of human beings

23:23:30.ar: بعث نوح لهداية قومه فكذّبوه فأغرق الله الكافرين بالطوفان
23:23:30.en: Prophet Nuh was sent to guide his people, they disbelieved him, as a result Allah drowned all disbelievers in great flood

23:31:32.ar: بعد نوح أرسل الله هودًا لهداية قومه
23:31:32.en: After prophet Nuh, Allah sent Hud to guide his people

23:33:45.ar: كذّبوا هودًا فأهلكهم الله بصيحة ثم أرسل رسلًا إلى أمم أخرى فكذّبوا ولقوا مصيرًا مشابهًا
23:33:45.en: They called Hud and imposter; as a result Allah destroyed them all in a mighty blast and After Hud Allah sent Rasools to other people, those people also denied and faced a similar punishment

23:46:51.ar: أُرسل موسى إلى فرعون وملئه فكذّبوا وهلكوا
23:46:51.en: Musa was sent to Fir'on and his chiefs; they also disbelieved and faced destruction

23:52:62.ar: قال الله: إن هذه أمتكم أمة واحدة وأنا ربكم فاتقون
23:52:62.en: Allah has said, "In fact, your religion is one religion; I am your Rabb, so fear Me alone"

23:63:78.ar: الله لا يكلّف نفسًا إلا وسعها ومن لا يؤمنون بالآخرة منحرفون عن الصراط
23:63:78.en: Allah has not charged any soul with more than it can bear and Those who do not believe in the hereafter will stray from the Right Path

23:79:84.ar: جعل الله لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة وقليلًا ما تشكرون
23:79:84.en: Allah has given you ears, eyes, and hearts, but you seldom show gratitude

23:85:91.en: Even the disbelievers recognize the existence of Allah

23:92:93.ar: ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معه من إله
23:92:93.en: Allah has never begotten a son, nor there is any other god besides Him

23:94:99.ar: ادفع بالتي هي أحسن واستعذ بالله من همزات الشياطين
23:94:99.en: Repel evil with good Seek refuge with Allah against the temptations of Shaitan

23:100:112.ar: يتمنى الظالمون العودة إلى الدنيا ليسلكوا الطريق الصحيح لكن بعد فوات الأوان
23:100:112.en: Wrongdoers will wish that they be sent back to this world to adopt the Right Way, but it will be too late

23:113:116.ar: يوم القيامة تبدو الحياة الدنيا أقلّ من يوم
23:113:116.en: On the day of Judgement it will appear as if the life of this world was less than a day

24:6:10.ar: اللعان بين الزوجين عند عدم وجود شهود في الزنا
24:6:10.en: Layan (accusing wife when there is no other witness in a case of adultery)

24:11:20.ar: الافتراء على زوجة النبي وتبرئة الله لها
24:11:20.en: Slander against a wife of the Holy Prophet and Allah declared the Prophet's wife to be innocent

24:21:26.ar: أمر الله المؤمنين بعدم اتباع الشيطان وعدم الخوض في الاتهامات الباطلة والافتراء
24:21:26.en: Allah commanded the believers not to follow Shaitan and not take Juz in false accusations and slanders

24:27:29.en: Etiquettes for entering the houses other than your own

24:30:31.ar: آداب المسلم في الاختلاط وفي مجالس الرجال والنساء
24:30:31.en: Required behavior of a Muslim in mixed traffic and gatherings of males and females

24:32:34.ar: الأمر بتزويج غير المتزوجين ومكاتبة العبيد الراغبين في حرّيتهم
24:32:34.en: Allah's order for single people to get married and Allah's order to grant liberty to those slaves who seek to buy their freedom

24:35:35.en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth

24:36:37.ar: نور الله في بيوت العبادة التي يذكره فيها عباده
24:36:37.en: Allah's Light is found in the places of worship which are built for his remembrance by His devotees

24:38:39.en: Deeds of unbelievers are like a mirage in a sandy desert

24:40:43.ar: كل شيء في السماوات والأرض يسبّح الله والله خلق كل دابة من ماء
24:40:43.en: Every thing in the heaven and earth glorify and praise Allah and Allah has created every living creature from water

24:44:48.ar: من يدّعون الإيمان ولا يظهرونه بالعمل ليسوا مؤمنين حقًّا
24:44:48.en: Those who claim to be the believers but do not demonstrate their belief through actions are not true believers

24:49:55.ar: المؤمنون الصادقون إذا دُعوا إلى الله ورسوله قالوا سمعنا وأطعنا
24:49:55.en: True believers are those who, when called towards Allah and His Rasool, say, "We hear and we obey"

24:56:57.ar: آداب الاستئذان قبل دخول غرفة الزوجين
24:56:57.en: Etiquettes of seeking permission to enter the room of married couple

24:58:59.ar: آداب الأكل في بيوت غير بيوتكم
24:58:59.en: Etiquettes of eating at houses other than your own

24:60:62.ar: وجوب حضور الاجتماعات التي تتطلب عملًا جماعيًّا
24:60:62.en: Requirement of attending meetings which require collective action

25:1:9.ar: تبارك الذي نزّل الفرقان والظالمون هم من ردّوا الحق وكذّبوا رسولًا لأنه بشر
25:1:9.en: Blessed is Allah Who revealed this Al-Quran, the criterion to distinguish right from wrong and Wrongdoers are those who reject the truth and disbelieve a Rasool be cause he is a human being

25:10:16.ar: من كذّب بالساعة والبعث يُلقى في النار المستعرة
25:10:16.en: Those who deny the Hour and life after death will be cast in the blazing fire

25:17:20.ar: يوم القيامة تتبرأ الآلهة التي دعاها المشركون من ألوهيتها وتحمّلهم مسؤولية شركهم
25:17:20.en: On the day of Judgement, those deities whom the Mushrikin invoke will deny any claim of divinity and hold the Mushrikin responsible for their shirk

25:21:24.ar: الكافرون الذين يطلبون الملائكة اليوم سيطلبون يوم القيامة حجرًا محجورًا بينهم وبين ملائكة العذاب
25:21:24.en: Unbelievers who ask for angels today will ask for a stone barrier between them and the angels of punishment

25:25:31.ar: يندم الكافرون يوم القيامة لأنهم لم يتخذوا سبيلًا إلى الحق
25:25:31.en: Disbelievers shall regret on the Day of Judgement not adopting the Right Path

25:32:34.ar: حكمة الله في نزول القرآن مفرّقًا لا جملة واحدة
25:32:34.en: Allah explains the wisdom behind revealing Al-Quran piecemeal rather than all at once

25:35:44.ar: الأمم التي كذّبت آيات الله ورسله أُهلكت، ومن اتخذ هواه إلهه كالأنعام
25:35:44.en: All nations which rejected Allah's revelations and His Rasools were utterly destroyed and Those who have taken their desires as their gods are nothing but animals

25:45:50.ar: جعل الله الليل لباسًا والنوم سباتًا والنهار نشورًا
25:45:50.en: Allah has made the night a mantle, sleep to rest, and the day to work

25:51:60.ar: لا تطع الكافرين وجاهدهم بالقرآن وتوكّل على الحي الذي لا يموت
25:51:60.en: Do not yield to the unbelievers; make Jihad against them with Al-Quran and Put your trust in Ever-Living (Allah), Who will never die

25:61:77.en: Characteristics of the True Servants (believers) of Allah

26:1:9.ar: حرص النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم على هداية الناس
26:1:9.en: Dedication of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) for the guidance of mankind

26:10:32.ar: إرسال موسى رسولًا وحواره مع فرعون ومعجزاته
26:10:32.en: Assignment of Musa as a Rasool and his dialogue with Fir'on and Miracles of Prophet Musa

26:33:51.ar: اعتبر فرعون معجزات موسى سحرًا وجمع السحرة للتحدي، فآمن السحرة جميعًا بعد رؤية المعجزة
26:33:51.en: Fir'on took Prophet Musa's miracles as magic and summoned the magicians to compete and After witnessing a miracle, all the magicians embraced Islam

26:52:68.ar: نجاة بني إسرائيل وهلاك فرعون وملئه
26:52:68.en: Deliverance of the Children of Israel and the destruction of Fir'on and his chiefs

26:69:104.ar: قصة إبراهيم ومحاجّته في عبادة الأصنام ودعاؤه للدنيا والآخرة ومصير المشركين وآلهتهم في جهنم
26:69:104.en: Story of Prophet Ibrahim and his arguments against idol worshipping and Prayer of Prophet Ibrahim for this life and the life hereafter and Mushrikin and their gods both will be toppled into hell

26:105:122.ar: قصة نوح وحواره مع قومه وكفرهم وهلاكهم
26:105:122.en: Story of Prophet Nuh, his dialogue with his people, they disbelieved and as a result faced destruction

26:123:140.ar: قصة هود ودعوته لقومه وكفرهم وهلاكهم
26:123:140.en: Story of Prophet Hud, his address to his people, they disbelieved and as a result faced destruction

26:141:159.ar: قصة صالح ودعوته لقومه وكفرهم وهلاكهم
26:141:159.en: Story of Prophet Saleh, his address to his people, they disbelieved and as a result faced destruction

26:160:175.ar: قصة لوط ودعوته لقومه وكفرهم وهلاكهم
26:160:175.en: Story of Prophet Lut, his address to his people, they disbelieved and as a result faced destruction

26:176:191.ar: قصة شعيب ودعوته لقومه وكفرهم وهلاكهم
26:176:191.en: Story of Prophet Shu'aib, his address to his people, they disbelieved and as a result faced destruction

26:192:207.ar: نزل القرآن بلسان عربي مبين على لسان جبريل ومن لا يريد الإيمان لن يؤمن
26:192:207.en: Al-Quran is revealed in plain Arabic by Allah through angel Gabriel, those people who do not want to believe will not believe

26:208:219.ar: ما تنزّلت به الشياطين، لا يصلح لهم ولا يستطيعونه
26:208:219.en: Al-Quran is not brought down by shaitans, it is neither in their interest nor in their power

26:220:226.ar: تنزّل الشياطين على كل أفاك أثيم
26:220:226.en: Shaitans descend on slandering sinners, who listen to hearsay and are liars

27:1:6.en: Al-Quran is a Guide and Good News to the Believers

27:7:14.ar: قصة اصطفاء موسى رسولًا وإراءة فرعون تسع آيات فكفر واستحق عذاب الله
27:7:14.en: Story of Prophet Musa's selection as a Rasool and Nine signs were shown to Fir'on but he still disbelieved and incurred Allah's punishment

27:15:19.ar: قصة سليمان الذي سخّر الله له الجن والإنس والطير والريح
27:15:19.en: Story of Prophet Sulaiman, to whom Allah gave rule over jinns, men, birds and winds

27:20:31.ar: الهدهد يأتيه بخبر ملكة سبأ ورسالة سليمان إلى الملكة
27:20:31.en: The hoopoe brought him the news about the Queen of Sheba and Letter from King Sulaiman to the Queen of Sheba

27:32:38.en: Communications between Queen of Sheba and Sulaiman

27:39:46.ar: الذي عنده علم من الكتاب يأتي بعرش الملكة في طرفة عين وإسلام ملكة سبأ وقومها
27:39:46.en: A man who had the 'Knowledge of the Book' brought Throne of the Queen to king Sulaiman in twinkling of and eye and Queen of Sheba and her people embraced Islam

27:47:55.ar: قصة صالح ودعوته لقومه وتآمرهم على قتله ونجاة الله له وإهلاك الكافرين
27:47:55.en: Story of Prophet Saleh and his address to his people and Saleh's people plotted to kill him but Allah saved him and destroyed the disbelievers

27:56:60.ar: نصح لوط لقومه فلم يستجيبوا فنزل بهم عذاب الله
27:56:60.en: Prophet Lut admonished his people but they paid no heed so they faced the scourge of Allah

27:61:61.en: Praise to Allah and peace be on His Rasools

27:62:68.ar: أإله مع الله خلق شيئًا في الكون أو يجيب المضطر أو يهدي إلى الصراط المستقيم؟
27:62:68.en: Just think, is there any god besides Allah Who has created anything in the universe, answer the oppressed or guides to the Right Way?

27:69:84.ar: شكّ الكافرين في قدرة الله على الخلق والقرآن يبيّن ما اختلف فيه بنو إسرائيل وآية من علامات الساعة
27:69:84.en: Disbelievers doubt Allah's power of creation and Al-Quran clarifies those matters in which the Israelites differ and A sign from the signs of doomsday

27:85:88.ar: لا تكذّبوا بآيات الله دون علم محيط بها
27:85:88.en: Do not deny Allah's revelations without gaining their comprehensive knowledge

27:89:95.ar: مشهد من مشاهد القيامة ومن اهتدى فلنفسه ومن ضلّ فعلى نفسه
27:89:95.en: A scene from the scenes of Doomsday and Those who accept guidance do so to their own good and those who go astray do so to their own peril

28:3:12.ar: فرعون يقتل أبناء بني إسرائيل ليحفظ ملكه والله يدبّر أن ينشأ أحدهم في بيته
28:3:12.en: Fir'on plotted to kill the sons of the Israelites to save his kingship, while Allah planned to bring up one of them in Fir'on's own household

28:13:20.ar: شباب موسى وقتله الرجل وهروبه من انتقام فرعون
28:13:20.en: Musa's youth, his folly of killing a man, and his escape from Fir'on's retribution

28:21:28.ar: وصوله إلى مدين وقبوله العمل عشر سنين وزواجه
28:21:28.en: His arrival at Madyan, acceptance of ten years term employment, and marriage

28:29:35.ar: وصوله إلى الطور ورؤيته النار ومناجاته لربه واصطفاؤه رسولًا إلى فرعون وملئه
28:29:35.en: His arrival at Mount Tur, seeing a fire, conversation with Allah, and his appointment as a Rasool to Fir'on and his chiefs

28:36:42.ar: كفر فرعون وملئه فأهلكهم الله ونجّى بني إسرائيل
28:36:42.en: Fir'on and his chiefs disbelieved; as result Allah destroyed them but saved the Children of Israel

28:43:50.ar: الأخبار عن إهلاك القرون السابقة للعبرة
28:43:50.en: Information about the destruction of prior generations is given to teach a lesson

28:51:55.ar: الصالحون من أهل الكتاب يعرفون صدق القرآن ويرون أنهم كانوا مسلمين قبله
28:51:55.en: Righteous Jews and Christians can recognize the truth of Al-Quran and feel that they were Muslims even before hearing it

28:56:60.ar: الأنبياء لا يهدون من أحبّوا بل الله يهدي من يشاء
28:56:60.en: Prophets cannot give guidance, it is Allah who gives guidance

28:61:67.ar: يتمنى الكافرون يوم القيامة لو أنهم اهتدوا
28:61:67.en: On the Day of Judgement disbelievers will wish that they had accepted Guidance

28:68:75.ar: ليست قدرات الله بيد المشركين ليعطوها لمن شاؤوا
28:68:75.en: Allah's powers are not in the hands of Mushrikin, that they can assign them to whomever they want

28:76:82.ar: قصة قارون الغني من قوم موسى الذي بغى وتمرّد على هدي الله
28:76:82.en: Story of Qarun, the rich man, who was from the people of Musa but he rebelled against the guidance of Allah

28:83:88.ar: نزول القرآن رحمة من الله فلا يصدّنّك عنه أحد
28:83:88.en: Revelation of Al-Quran is the mercy of Allah, let no one turn you away from it

29:1:6.ar: الله يبتلي المؤمنين ليعلم الصادقين والكاذبين
29:1:6.en: Allah tests the believers to see who is truthful and who is a liar

29:7:12.ar: الإحسان إلى الوالدين دون طاعتهما في الشرك والذين يقولون اتبعوا سبيلنا ولنحمل خطاياكم كاذبون
29:7:12.en: Be kind to your parents but do not obey them in the matter of shirk and Those who say, "Follow us we will bear your burden," are liars

29:13:21.ar: نوح يدعو قومه ألف سنة إلا خمسين عامًا ألا يشركوا وكذلك إبراهيم
29:13:21.en: Nuh admonished his people not to commit shirk for 950 years Likewise, Ibrahim admonished his people not to commit shirk

29:22:26.ar: حاول قوم إبراهيم حرقه فنجّاه الله ولم يؤمن له إلا لوط ابن أخيه
29:22:26.en: The people of Ibrahim even tried to burn him alive but Allah saved him and Lut (his nephew) is the only one who affirmed his belief with him

29:27:30.en: Lut was appointed as a Rasool towards the nation of homosexuals

29:31:35.ar: رفضوا هدى الله فأهلكهم الله جميعًا
29:31:35.en: They rejected Allah's guidance; as a result Allah destroyed them all

29:36:40.ar: وكذلك عاد وثمود ومدين وفرعون كذّبوا رسل الله فهلكوا
29:36:40.en: Likewise the Nations of 'Ad, Thamud, Madyan and Fir'on rejected the Rasools of Allah, which resulted in their destruction

29:41:44.ar: مثل من اتخذوا من دون الله أولياء
29:41:44.en: Parable of those who take protectors other than Allah

29:45:51.ar: الصلاة تنهى عن الفحشاء والمنكر والنهي عن مجادلة أهل الكتاب إلا بالتي هي أحسن
29:45:51.en: Salah keeps one away from the shameful deeds and Do not argue with the People of the Book except in good taste

29:52:63.ar: من آمن بالباطل وكفر بالله خاسر، وكم من دابة لا تحمل رزقها الله يرزقها وإياكم
29:52:63.en: Those who believe in falsehood and disbelieve Allah shall be the losers and How many creatures are there who do not carry their provisions with them ? Allah provides them as He provides you

29:64:69.ar: الحياة الدنيا لهو ولعب والحياة الحقيقية في الآخرة والذين جاهدوا فينا لنهدينّهم سبلنا
29:64:69.en: The life of this world is nothing but a pastime, the real life is the life Hereafter and Those who strive in Our cause, We do guide them to Our Way

30:1:9.ar: هزيمة الروم النصارى أمام الفرس الوثنيين فُهمت بشارة بهزيمة المسلمين أمام كفار العرب فبشّر الله بنصر الروم ونصر المسلمين بعد سنوات
30:1:9.en: Romans (Christians) defeat at the hands of Persian (Pagans) was taken as a sign of the Muslims defeat at the hands of Arab's unbelievers, so Allah gave good tidings for Roman's victory as well as Muslims victory in a few year

30:10:18.ar: الله يبدأ الخلق ثم يعيده وإليه يُرجعون للحساب
30:10:18.en: It is Allah Who originates the creation and then repeats it and to Him everyone will be brought for the final Judgement

30:19:26.ar: خلق الإنسان وزوجه والسماوات والأرض واختلاف الألسنة والألوان والنوم والسعي للرزق والبرق والمطر وإنبات الزرع من آيات الله
30:19:26.en: Creation of Man, his consort, heavens, earth, language, colors, sleep, quest for work, lightening, rain and growth of vegetation are all from the signs of Allah

30:27:31.ar: الظالمون يتبعون أهواءهم بغير علم، والإيمان الحقّ وحال الفرق
30:27:31.en: Wrongdoers are led by their own appetites without real knowledge and  True faith and the nature of sects

30:32:36.ar: إذا مسّ الناس ضرّ دعوا الله فإذا كشفه عنهم أشركوا
30:32:36.en: When and affliction befalls people they call upon Allah, but when He relieves them, lo! They start committing shirk

30:37:39.ar: الأمر بإعطاء ذي القربى حقه والمسكين وابن السبيل
30:37:39.en: Commandment to give the relatives their due and likewise to the poor and the travellers in need

30:40:44.ar: ظهر الفساد في الأرض بما كسبت أيدي الناس ليذيقهم الله ثمرة أعمالهم
30:40:44.en: Mischief in the land is the result of Man's own misdeeds, that's how Allah let them taste the fruit of their deeds

30:45:52.ar: أرسل الله رسله لهداية الناس فآمن بعضهم وكفر بعضهم وانتقم من المجرمين ونصر المؤمنين، ولا تُسمع الموتى
30:45:52.en: Allah sent His Rasools for the guidance of people, some believed while other rejected, Allah subjected the guilty to His retribution and helped the Believers and O Prophet you cannot make the dead to hear you

30:53:59.en: It is Allah Who has created you and shall bring you to justice on the Day of Judgement

31:1:10.ar: القرآن كتاب الحكمة وهدى ورحمة للمحسنين
31:1:10.en: AL-Quran is the Book of Wisdom, a Guide and a Blessing for the Righteous

31:11:12.ar: لقمان ينصح ابنه بألا يشرك بالله
31:11:12.en: Luqman advised his son not to commit Shirk

31:13:14.ar: حقّ الأم والوالدين وطاعتهما إلا في الشرك
31:13:14.en: Rights of mother and the parents and  Obey your parents but not in the matters of Shirk

31:15:18.en: Advise of Luqman about moral behavior and interaction

31:19:23.ar: سبب الضلال الرئيسي هو التقليد الأعمى للآباء
31:19:23.en: Main reason of misguidance is the blind following of ones forefathers

31:24:29.ar: لو أن الأشجار أقلام والبحر مداد لما نفدت كلمات الله، والله هو الحق وما يدعون من دونه باطل
31:24:29.en: If all the trees were pens and the oceans and ink, Allah's words could not be put to writing and  Allah is the only reality, all others to whom people invoke besides Him are false

31:30:33.ar: اتقوا يومًا لا يجزي والد عن ولده ولا مولود عن والده ولا يغرّنكم الشيطان
31:30:33.en: O Mankind, fear that Day when no father shall avail his son nor a son his father Let not the Shaitan deceive you concerning this fact

32:1:11.ar: القرآن لا ريب فيه أُنزل على محمد لينذر قومًا لم يأتهم نذير من قبله
32:1:11.en: AL-Quran is beyond all doubts, revealed to Muhammad, so that he may warn those people to whom no Warner has come before

32:12:14.ar: يوم القيامة يؤمن الكافرون ولا ينفعهم إيمانهم
32:12:14.en: On the Day of Judgement the unbelievers shall believe but that belief will be of no benefit to them

32:15:22.ar: جزاء خاص لمن تتجافى جنوبهم عن المضاجع يدعون ربهم خوفًا وطمعًا وينفقون
32:15:22.en: There is a special reward for those who forsake their beds and invoke their Rabb with fear and hope and spend in charity

32:23:30.ar: القرآن كتاب كالكتاب الذي أُعطيه موسى
32:23:30.en: AL-Quran is the similar Book as the Book which was given to Prophet Musa

33:1:3.ar: اتقِ الله ولا تطع الكافرين والمنافقين
33:1:3.en: Fear Allah and do not obey the unbelievers and hypocrites

33:4:5.ar: لا تصير الزوجات أمهات ولا الأدعياء أبناء بمجرد الكلام
33:4:5.en: By words of mouth neither your wives become your mothers nor adopted sons become your real sons

33:6:8.ar: أزواج النبي أمهات المؤمنين وأولو الأرحام أولى ببعض في كتاب الله
33:6:8.en: Prophet's wives are believers' mothers and Blood relations have greater claims than others in the Book of Allah

33:9:11.en: Favors of Allah during the battle of Trench

33:12:15.en: Attitude of the Hypocrites during the battle of Trench

33:16:20.ar: من يثبّطون عن القتال ولا يقاتلون هم ولا إيمان لهم وأعمالهم حابطة
33:16:20.en: Those who discourage others from participating in fight against the unbelievers and don't participate in such a war themselves have no faith and all their deeds will be void

33:21:24.ar: لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أسوة حسنة
33:21:24.en: The Life of Rasool Allah (Muhammad) is the best Model for you

33:25:27.ar: نصر الله المسلمين على الكافرين وعلى يهود المدينة وخيبر
33:25:27.en: Allah helped the Muslims to gain victory over the unbelievers and the Jewish tribes in Madinah and Khayber

33:28:30.ar: وعظ أزواج النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
33:28:30.en: Admonition to the wives of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

33:31:34.en: Allah's commandment to the wives of Prophet Muhammad

33:35:36.ar: ليس للمؤمنين خيرة فيما قضاه الله ورسوله
33:35:36.en: It is not fitting for believers to have option in what has been decided by Allah and His Rasool

33:37:40.ar: أمر الله نبيّه بالزواج من مطلّقة ابنه بالتبنّي زيد، ومحمد ليس أبا أحد من رجالكم بل رسول الله وخاتم النبيين
33:37:40.en: Allah commanded Prophet Muhammad to marry the divorced wife of his adopted son Zaid and Muhammad is not the father of any of your men but a Rasool and Seal of the Prophethood

33:41:48.ar: أُرسل النبي شاهدًا ومبشرًا ونذيرًا وسراجًا منيرًا
33:41:48.en: Prophet is sent as a bearer of good news, a Warner and a lamp spreading light

33:49:52.ar: الطلاق قبل المسّ لا عدّة فيه وإباحة خاصة للنبي بالزواج بأكثر من أربع وحظر استبدال زوجاته بعد ذلك
33:49:52.en: Divorce when no Iddat (waiting period for remarriage) is required and Special permission for Prophet Muhammad to marry more than four wives and Restriction on Prophet to marry or exchange the present wives after this commandment

33:53:55.ar: النهي عن دخول بيوت النبي بغير إذن وعدم الإطالة في الحديث والنهي عن نكاح أزواجه من بعده
33:53:55.en: Do not enter the houses of the Prophet without permission, and if invited do not seek long conversation and Do not marry Rasool's wives after his death

33:56:58.ar: الله وملائكته يصلّون على النبي فصلّوا عليه أيها المؤمنون
33:56:58.en: Allah Himself and His angels send blessings on the Prophet, O Believers invoke Allah's blessings for him

33:59:59.en: Commandment of Hijab (dress code) for women

33:60:62.en: Punishment for the Hypocrites and scandal mongers

33:63:68.ar: الكافرون في جهنم يطلبون مضاعفة العذاب على زعمائهم
33:63:68.en: In Hell the unbelievers shall ask double punishment for their leaders

33:69:73.ar: اتقوا الله وقولوا قولًا سديدًا وعُرضت الأمانة على السماوات والأرض والجبال فأبين وحملها الإنسان
33:69:73.en: O Believers! Fear Allah and always say the right thing and Heavens, Earth and Mountains refuse to take Allah's Trust but the Man took it

34:1:5.ar: الساعة آتية ويوم القيامة يكافئ المؤمنين ويعاقب المكذّبين بآيات الله
34:1:5.en: The Hour is surely going to come and the Day of Judgement shall be established to reward the believers and punish those who discredit Allah's revelations

34:6:9.en: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter are doomed

34:10:14.ar: الجبال والطير تسبّح مع داود وسخّر الله لسليمان الريح والجن وزعم الناس أن الجن يعلمون الغيب باطل
34:10:14.en: Mountains and birds use to sing Allah's Rhymes with Prophet Dawood and Allah subjected the winds and Jinns to Prophet Sulaiman and Claim of people that Jinns know the unseen is wrong

34:15:21.ar: أهل سبأ كفروا بنعم الله وأنكروا الآخرة فجعلهم الله أحاديث
34:15:21.en: The people of Saba rejected Allah's blessings and disbelieved in the Hereafter so Allah made them merely a tale of the past

34:22:30.ar: لا تنفع الشفاعة عند الله إلا لمن أذن له ومحمد أُرسل للناس كافة
34:22:30.en: No intercession before Allah can avail any one except for   whom He permits it and Prophet Muhammad is sent for the entire mankind

34:31:36.ar: الكافرون بالقرآن والكتب السابقة تُجعل الأغلال في أعناقهم ثم يُلقون في جهنم والمال والأولاد ليسا دليل رضا الله
34:31:36.en: Those who disbelieve in AL-Quran and prior scriptures will be subjected to yokes around their necks before tossing them into Hell and Wealth and children are not the indications of Allah's pleasure

34:37:45.ar: الإيمان هو الذي يقرّبكم إلى الله لا المال والأولاد وما أنفقتم فهو يخلفه وأقوال الكافرين في النبي والقرآن
34:37:45.en: It is belief that brings you close to Allah not the wealth or children and Whatever you spend in charity, Allah will pay you back and Unbeliever's statements about the Prophet and AL-Quran

34:46:50.ar: يُدعى الكافرون إلى التفكّر في أقوالهم الباطلة، وجاء الحق وما يبدئ الباطل وما يعيد
34:46:50.en: Unbelievers are asked to ponder upon their wrong statements and Truth has come, falsehood neither originates nor restores anything

34:51:54.ar: يوم القيامة يريد الكافرون الإيمان ولا ينفعهم
34:51:54.en: On the Day of Judgement unbelievers would like to believe but it will be of no avail to them

35:1:7.ar: لا مانع ولا معطي إلا الله والشيطان عدوّ لكم فاتخذوه عدوًّا
35:1:7.en: None can withhold or award blessings besides Allah and Shaitan is your enemy, so take him as your enemy

35:8:9.ar: من زُيّن له سوء عمله فرآه حسنًا لا يُهدى
35:8:9.en: That person who consider his evil deeds to be good cannot be guided to the Right Path

35:10:11.ar: من كان يريد العزّة فلله العزّة جميعًا
35:10:11.en: Let all those who are seeking honor know that real honor is in the obedience of Allah

35:12:14.ar: خلق الله الماء والليل والنهار والشمس والقمر لمنفعة الإنسان والآلهة من دونه لا تسمع ولا تجيب ولا تملك قطميرًا
35:12:14.en: Allah has created water, day, night, sun and moon for man's benefit and Deities besides Allah can neither hear, nor response nor yet own even a thread of a date-stone

35:15:18.ar: الناس فقراء إلى الله والله غني عنهم
35:15:18.en: Mankind is in need of Allah, while He is not in need of any one

35:19:26.ar: لا يستوي الأحياء ولا الأموات وما أنت بمسمع من في القبور
35:19:26.en: Living and dead are not alike You cannot make those who are buried in the grave hear you

35:27:37.ar: من يتلون القرآن ويقيمون الصلاة وينفقون يرجون تجارة لن تبور والكافرون لهم عذاب شديد في النار خالدين
35:27:37.en: Those who recite AL-Quran, establish Salah and give charity may hope for Allah's blessings and rewards and Those who disbelieve shall have a painful punishment in the Hell-Fire forever

35:38:41.ar: ما أنزل الله كتابًا فيه إجازة للشرك
35:38:41.en: Allah has not sent any Book which has a provision of Shirk (worshipping any one else besides Allah)

35:42:46.ar: لا يحيق المكر السيّئ إلا بأهله ولو يؤاخذ الله الناس بما كسبوا ما ترك على ظهرها من دابة
35:42:46.en: Plotting evil recoil none but the author of it and If Allah was to punish people for their wrong doings, He would have not left even and animal around

36:1:11.ar: القرآن نزل لينذر الناس والنبي لا ينذر إلا من خشي الرحمن
36:1:11.en: AL-Quran is revealed by the Allah to warn people and Prophet is told that he could warn only those people who have the fear of Allah

36:12:20.ar: مثل ثلاثة رسل أُرسلوا إلى قرية فكذّبهم أهلها إلا رجلًا جاء من أقصى المدينة
36:12:20.en: And example of three Prophets who were sent to one town, all denied them except one man who came from cross the town

36:21:31.ar: أكرم الله الرجل المؤمن بالجنة وأهلك الكافرين
36:21:31.en: Allah blessed the man who believed with Paradise and destroyed the disbelievers

36:32:35.en: Allah has created all things in pair

36:36:39.ar: الليل والنهار والشمس والقمر كلها بتدبير الله
36:36:39.en: Day, night, sun and moon; all are being regulated by Allah

36:40:49.ar: موقف الكافرين من الإنفاق في سبيل الله
36:40:49.en: Disbeliever's attitude towards spending in the way of Allah

36:50:53.en: A scene from the Day of Judgement

36:54:57.en: Allah's greeting to the residents of Paradise

36:58:66.ar: خطاب الله للمجرمين، ويوم القيامة تشهد الأيدي والأرجل
36:58:66.en: Allah's address to the criminal sinners and On the Day of judgement hands and feet shall testify

36:67:75.ar: القرآن لينذر من كان حيًّا ويحقّ القول على الكافرين
36:67:75.en: AL-Quran is to warn those who are alive and to establish charge against the disbelievers

36:76:82.ar: الذي خلق الإنسان سيعيد إحياءه للحساب يوم القيامة
36:76:82.en: Allah, Who has created the man, shall give him life again, for accountability on the Day of Judgement

37:1:11.ar: الله يشهد أن إلهكم واحد وأن الشياطين لا تصل إلى الملأ الأعلى
37:1:11.en: Allah testifies that your God is one God and that shaitans do not have and excess to the exalted assembly of angels

37:12:21.en: Life in the Hereafter and the Day of Judgement are real

37:22:39.ar: مشهد من القيامة ومعاملة الظالمين وحوار بين التابعين والمتبوعين الضالين
37:22:39.en: A scene from the Day of Judgement and a treatment for the wrongdoers and A dialogue between the followers and the leaders who mislead them

37:40:61.ar: مشهد من مشاهد الجنة ومثال على حديث أحد أهلها
37:40:61.en: A scene from the scenes of Paradise and And example of conversation from a resident of Paradise

37:62:74.en: A scene from the scenes of Hell

37:75:82.en: Prophet Nuh prayed and Allah respond to his prayers

37:83:98.en: Story of Prophet Ibrahim, "The Friend of Allah"

37:99:113.ar: أُمر إبراهيم بذبح ابنه الوحيد اختبارًا فامتثل
37:99:113.en: Prophet Ibrahim was asked to offer his only son in sacrifice as a test and he fulfilled it

37:114:122.en: Allah bestowed His favors on Prophets Musa and Haroon

37:123:130.en: Ilyas (Elias) was one of the Rasools of Allah

37:131:138.en: Lut was also a Rasool of Allah

37:149:166.ar: زعم المشركين أن الملائكة بنات الله وأن بين الله والجن نسبًا باطل تمامًا
37:149:166.en: Mushrik's claim of Angels being daughters of Allah and Jinns having blood relations with Allah are utterly false

37:167:182.en: Allah has promised to help His Rasools and His devotees

38:1:13.ar: القرآن ذكرى وتكبّر الكافرين في تكذيب النبي
38:1:13.en: AL-Quran is full of admonition Unbelievers are in sheer arrogance for calling the Prophet as liars

38:14:25.ar: قصة داود، تسبيح الجبال والطير معه، وقصة الخصمين اللذين جاءاه
38:14:25.en: Story of Prophet Dawood -mountains and birds used to sing the rhymes of Allah and Story of the two litigants who came to Dawood for a decision

38:26:28.ar: ما خلق الله السماء والأرض باطلًا
38:26:28.en: Allah has not created the heavens and the earth in vain

38:29:39.ar: قصة عرض سليمان للخيل المعدّة للجهاد ودعاؤه بملك لا ينبغي لأحد بعده
38:29:39.en: Story of Sulaiman's inspection of steeds to be used in Jihad and  Prophet Sulaiman's prayer of granting him a kingdom, similar of which may not be granted to any one else

38:40:47.en: Story of Ayub (Job), his sickness and relief

38:48:63.ar: القرآن ذكرى بجزاء الجنة وعقوبة النار
38:48:63.en: AL-Quran is but a reminder about the reward of Paradise and punishment of the hellfire

38:64:69.ar: مهمة الرسل الإنذار وإعلان أنه لا إله إلا الله
38:64:69.en: The mission of the Rasools' is to warn people and declare that there is no divinity except Allah

38:70:86.en: Story of the creation of Adam and disobedience of Iblees (Shaitan)

39:1:10.ar: يبرّر المشركون عبادة الأولياء بأنها تقرّبهم إلى الله ولا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى
39:1:10.en: Mushrikin try to justify their worship to saints saying that it may bring us closer to Allah and On the Day of Judgement no bearer of burden shall bear the burden of another

39:11:17.ar: من لا يستطيع إقامة دينه فليهاجر والخاسرون حقًّا من خسروا أنفسهم وأهليهم يوم القيامة
39:11:17.en: Believers who cannot practice their faith (Islam) should migrate to other places where they can and The real losers are those who shall lose their souls and their families on the Day of Judgement

39:18:20.ar: لا ينقذ أحد من حقّت عليه كلمة العذاب
39:18:20.en: No one can rescue the one against whom the sentence of punishment has been decreed

39:21:30.ar: القرآن متشابه مثاني وضرب الله فيه من كل مثل ليتذكر الناس
39:21:30.en: AL-Quran is consistent in its verses yet repeats its teachings in different ways and Allah has cited every kind of parable in AL-Quran so that people may learn a lesson

39:31:38.ar: من أظلم ممن كذب على الله؟ وإن أراد الله بكم ضرًّا فلا كاشف له وإن أراد رحمة فلا ممسك لها
39:31:38.en: Who can be more wicked than the one who invent a lie against Allah? And If Allah intends to harm you, no one can save you and if He intends to bestow His blessings, no one can withhold

39:39:43.ar: الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها
39:39:43.en: It is Allah Who recall the souls of people upon their death and of the living people during their sleep

39:44:49.ar: لو أن للظالمين ما في الأرض جميعًا ومثله معه لافتدوا به يوم القيامة
39:44:49.en: If the wrong doers possess all the treasures of the earth and much more besides it, they will gladly offer it as a ransom to redeem themselves on the Day of Judgement

39:50:60.ar: الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا يقنطوا من رحمة الله وليتوبوا ما دام الوقت
39:50:60.en: Those who have transgressed against their souls should not despair of Allah's mercy, they should repent while they can

39:61:67.ar: اعبد الله وكن من الشاكرين ويوم القيامة يوضع الكتاب ويُقضى بالحق
39:61:67.en: Worship Allah and be among His thankful servants and On the Day of Judgement the Book of Deeds will be lai open and justice will be done with all fairness

39:68:72.ar: بعد الحساب يُساق الكافرون إلى جهنم والمتقون إلى الجنة
39:68:72.en: After Judgement unbelievers will driven to Hell and the righteous will be led to Paradise

40:1:8.ar: لا يجادل في آيات الله إلا الكافرون وملائكة العرش يستغفرون للتائبين المتبعين سبيل الله
40:1:8.en: No one disputes the revelations of Allah except the kafirs (unbelievers) and The angels who bear the Throne of Allah pray for those who repent and follow the Right Way

40:9:20.ar: مشهد من يوم القيامة وخائنة الأعين وما تخفي الصدور
40:9:20.en: A scene from the Day of Judgement and Furtive looks and the secret thoughts

40:21:22.ar: من كذّبوا الأنبياء وآيات الله أُهلكوا جميعًا
40:21:22.en: Those who denied the Prophets and Allah's revelations were all destroyed

40:23:27.ar: أُرسل موسى إلى فرعون وهامان وقارون وفرعون يريد قتل موسى
40:23:27.en: Prophet Musa was sent to Fir'on, Haman and Qarun and Fir'on intended to kill Prophet Musa

40:28:37.ar: كلام حسن لرجل من آل فرعون دفاعًا عن موسى
40:28:37.en: And excellent speech of one of the relatives of Fir'on in the favor of Prophet Musa

40:38:50.ar: نجّى الله ذلك المؤمن من مكر فرعون وأهلك آل فرعون ويُعرضون على النار غدوًّا وعشيًّا (عذاب القبر)
40:38:50.en: Allah saved that believer from the plots of Fir'on and destroyed the people of Fir'on, now they are presented before the fire of Hell morning and evening (punishment of the graves)

40:51:61.ar: الله ينصر رسله والمؤمنين في الدنيا وفي الآخرة وقال ربكم ادعوني أستجب لكم
40:51:61.en: Allah does help His Rasools and the believers in this world's life and will help them in the life Hereafter and Your Rabb says, "Call on Me, I will answer your prayers"

40:62:68.ar: لا معبود بحق إلا الله خالق ورب العالمين
40:62:68.en: No one has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Creator and the Rabb of the worlds

40:69:77.ar: الذين يجادلون في آيات الله سيعلمون الحق وأرسل الله رسلًا كثيرين قبل محمد منهم من ذُكر في القرآن ومنهم من لم يُذكر
40:69:77.en: Those who argue about the revelations of Allah, will soon fin out the Truth and  Allah has sent many Rasools before Muhammad; some are mentioned in AL-Quran and some are not

40:78:84.ar: الأنعام آيات الله لأولي الألباب ولا ينفع الكافرين الإيمان بعد رؤية العذاب
40:78:84.en: Cattle are the signs of Allah for the people of understanding and Belief after seeing the scourge of Allah is of no avail to the disbelievers

41:1:7.ar: القرآن بشير ونذير والويل لمنكري الآخرة وتاركي الزكاة
41:1:7.en: AL-Quran is a giver of good news and and admonition and Woe to those who deny the Hereafter and do not pay Zakah

41:8:11.ar: قصة خلق الأرض والجبال والفصول والسماوات
41:8:11.en: Story of the creation of earth, mountains, seasons, skies and heavens

41:12:17.ar: تحذير الكافرين ومثل عذاب الله على عاد وثمود
41:12:17.en: Warning to the disbelievers and the example of Allah's scourge upon the nations of A'd and Thamud

41:18:24.ar: يوم القيامة تشهد على الناس أسماعهم وأبصارهم وجلودهم بما عملوا
41:18:24.en: On the Day of Judgement people's own ears, eyes and skins will bear witness against them relating to their misdeeds

41:25:31.ar: من لا يستمع للقرآن يُعاقب شديدًا والذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقاموا تتنزّل عليهم الملائكة
41:25:31.en: Those who do not listen to Al-Quran shall be sternly punished   and those who listen to those who say our God is Allah and then stay firm on it, angels are assigned for their protection

41:32:43.ar: أحسن القول الدعوة إلى الله وعمل الصالح وقول إنني من المسلمين ومثال من آيات الله وما يُقال لمحمد إلا ما قيل للرسل من قبله والقرآن هدى وشفاء للمؤمنين
41:32:43.en: The best in speech is the one who calls people towards Allah, do good deeds and say, "I am a Muslim" And Example of Allah's signs and Nothing is said to Muhammad which was not said to the prior Prophets and AL-Quran is a guide and healing for the believers

41:44:45.ar: الكتاب الذي أُعطيه موسى كان مثل القرآن
41:44:45.en: The Book given to Prophet Musa was similar to AL-Quran

41:46:50.ar: يوم القيامة تتلاشى كل الآلهة التي عبدها الناس من دون الله
41:46:50.en: On the Day of Judgement all other gods to whom people worship besides Allah shall vanish

41:51:53.ar: أرأيتم إن كان القرآن من عند الله ثم كفرتم به فما حالكم؟
41:51:53.en: Have you ever considered that if Al-Quran is really from Allah and you deny it, what will happen to you

42:1:7.ar: تكاد السماوات يتفطّرن من فوقهن ممن رفعوا مخلوقات الله إلى مقامه لولا أن الملائكة يستغفرون لمن في الأرض
42:1:7.en: The heavens might have broken apart from above those who elevate Allah's creatures to His rank if the angels were not begging forgiveness for the residents of earth

42:8:17.ar: الإسلام هو الدين الذي وصّى به نوحًا وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى، وأُمروا جميعًا بإقامة الدين وعدم التفرّق فيه
42:8:17.en: Islam is the same Deen (way of life) which was enjoined on Nuh, Ibrahim, Musa (Moses) and Isa (Jesus) They were all ordered to establish Deen-al-Islam and do not create division (sects) in it

42:18:27.ar: من أراد حرث الآخرة زدنا له في حرثه ومن أراد حرث الدنيا أوتي منها وليس له في الآخرة نصيب
42:18:27.en: He who desires the harvest in the hereafter shall be given many folds, but he who desires in this life shall be given a portion here but shall have no share in the hereafter

42:28:40.ar: ما أصاب الناس من مصيبة فبما كسبت أيديهم والمؤمنون الحقّ يقيمون الصلاة وينفقون وينتصرون إذا ظُلموا
42:28:40.en: Whatever afflictions befall upon people are the result of their own misdeeds and True believers are those who establish Salah, give charit and defend themselves when oppressed

42:41:45.ar: الخاسرون حقًّا هم من خسروا يوم القيامة
42:41:45.en: The real losers are those who will lose on the Day of Resurrection

42:46:47.ar: الله يهب لمن يشاء إناثًا ويهب لمن يشاء الذكور
42:46:47.en: It is Allah Who gives daughters and sons as He pleases

42:48:50.ar: ما كان لبشر أن يكلّمه الله إلا وحيًا أو من وراء حجاب
42:48:50.en: It is not vouchsafed for any human being that Allah should speak to him face to face

43:1:7.ar: القرآن نسخة من أمّ الكتاب عند الله
43:1:7.en: Al-Quran is a transcript from the Mother Book which is in Allah's keeping

43:8:14.ar: حتى المشركون يقرّون بأن الله خلق السماوات والأرض وما فيهن ودعاء ركوب الدابة
43:8:14.en: Even the Mushrikin believe that heavens, earth and all therein is created by Allah and Supplication before riding a conveyance

43:15:24.ar: بعض المشركين يعدّون الملائكة إناثًا وبنات الله
43:15:24.en: Some Mushrikin regard the angels to be the female divinities being the daughters of Allah

43:25:34.ar: إبراهيم يوحّد الله ويتبرأ من الشرك ولولا أن يكون الناس أمة واحدة كافرة لجعل الله بيوت الكافرين سقفًا من فضة
43:25:34.en: Prophet Ibrahim recognized the Oneness of Allah and rejected Shirk (Polytheism) and If it were not that all mankind will become one race of unbelievers, Allah would have given the unbeliever houses made with sterling silver

43:35:44.ar: من أعرض عن ذكر الله قيّض له شيطانًا فهو له قرين، فاستمسك بالقرآن لتهتدي
43:35:44.en: He who turns away from the remembrance of Allah, Allah appoints a Shaitan to be his intimate friend and Hold fast to Al-Quran if you want to be rightly guided

43:45:56.ar: أُرسل موسى بآيات إلى فرعون وملئه فسخروا منه ومن الآيات فأغرقهم الله جميعًا
43:45:56.en: Prophet Musa was sent to Fir'on and his chiefs with signs but they ridicule him and the signs as a result Allah drowned them all

43:57:67.ar: عيسى بشر أنعم الله عليه وجعله مثلًا لبني إسرائيل
43:57:67.en: Prophet Isa (Jesus) was no more than a mortal whom Allah favored and made him and example for the Children of Israel

43:68:89.ar: يوم القيامة لا خوف على المؤمنين ولا هم يحزنون ويدخلون الجنة مسرورين وقل للنصارى: لو كان للرحمن ولد فأنا أول العابدين
43:68:89.en: On the Day of Judgement believers will have no fear or regret, they will be warded paradise and made happy and O Prophet tell the Christians, if Allah had a son, I would have been the first one to worship him

44:1:15.ar: أنزل الله القرآن في الليلة المباركة (ليلة القدر) التي يُفرق فيها كل أمر حكيم
44:1:15.en: Allah revealed this Quran in the Blessed Night (Layla-tul-Qadr) in which all matters are decided wisely by His command

44:16:28.ar: عبر من قصة موسى وآل فرعون
44:16:28.en: Lessons to be learned from the story of Prophet Musa and the people of Fir'on

44:29:40.ar: نجّى الله بني إسرائيل واصطفاهم على العالمين على ضعفهم ويوم الفصل ميقات البعث
44:29:40.en: Allah delivered the Children of Israel and chose them over the nations of the world inspite of their weaknesses and Day of Sorting Out is the time appointed for resurrection

44:41:47.en: Food and drink for the sinners in hell

44:48:56.en: Food and entertainment for the righteous in paradise

45:1:10.ar: في الكون آيات لمن يطلبونها، فإن لم يؤمنوا بالله وآياته فبأي حديث يؤمنون؟
45:1:10.en: Food for thought to those who are seeking the signs of Allah and If they do not believe in Allah and His revelations then in what report will they believe?

45:11:16.ar: سخّر الله البحار وما بين السماوات والأرض للإنسان، وتفرّق بنو إسرائيل في دينهم بعد ما جاءهم العلم
45:11:16.en: Allah has subjected the seas and all that is between the heavens and the earth for human beings and  Israelites made sects in their religion after the knowledge has come to them through Torah

45:17:20.ar: الظالمون بعضهم أولياء بعض والله ولي المتقين
45:17:20.en: Wrongdoers are protectors of one another while the protector of righteous is Allah Himself

45:21:25.ar: من اتخذ إلهه هواه أضلّه الله وختم على سمعه وقلبه
45:21:25.en: He who has made his own desires as his god, Allah let him go astray and set a seal upon his ears and heart

45:26:36.en: Allah's address to the disbelievers on the day of judgement

46:1:5.ar: خلق الله السماوات والأرض وما بينهما بالحق، والآلهة التي يدعوها المشركون غافلة عن دعائهم
46:1:5.en: Allah created the heavens, earth and all that lies between them to manifest the truth and Those deities to whom Mushrikin invoke are not even aware that they are being invoked

46:6:9.ar: القرآن كلام الله لا كلام النبي والنبي نذير مبين
46:6:9.en: Al-Quran is the word of Allah, not the Prophet and Prophet is but a plain Warner

46:10:13.ar: القرآن يصدّق وحي التوراة الذي أُعطيه موسى
46:10:13.en: Al-Quran conforms the revelation of Torah given to Prophet Musa

46:14:19.ar: البار بوالديه مكافأ والعاقّ لهما معاقب
46:14:19.en: Those who treat their parents with kindness shall be rewarded and those who rebuke their parents shall be punished

46:20:25.ar: قوم عاد كذّبوا رسالة الله فهلكوا
46:20:25.en: Nation of A'd rejected Allah's message, as a result she faced destruction

46:26:27.ar: لا إله ينقذ الناس من غضب الله
46:26:27.en: No deity can save people from the wrath of Allah

46:28:33.ar: نفر من الجن آمنوا بعد سماع القرآن وصاروا دعاة إلى قومهم
46:28:33.en: A group of jinns embraced Islam after hearing Al-Quran and became the preachers to their folk

46:34:34.ar: استمر في تبليغ رسالة الله واصبر على الكافرين
46:34:34.en: Keep on passing the message of Allah and bear the disbelievers with patience

47:1:4.en: Allah void the deeds of the disbelievers

47:5:7.ar: في الحرب أثخنوا في الكافرين قبل أخذ الأسرى
47:5:7.en: In case of war thoroughly subdue the unbelievers before taking prisoners of war

47:8:12.ar: إن تنصروا الله ينصركم ويثبّت أقدامكم
47:8:12.en: If you help the cause of Allah, Allah will help and protect you

47:13:15.en: Believers do not follow their own desires

47:17:20.ar: المنافقون هم الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم
47:17:20.en: Hypocrites are those on whose heart Allah has set a seal

47:21:29.ar: الوعد بالطاعة والقول الحسن الذي لا يتبعه عمل ممقوت عند الله
47:21:29.en: Promise of obedience (Islam) and good talk which is not followed by action is cursed by Allah

47:30:35.ar: ابتلى الله المؤمنين ليعلم المجاهدين والصابرين
47:30:35.en: Allah put the believers to test in order to know the valiant and the resolute

47:36:37.en: In the case of war Allah is on the side of the believers

47:38:39.ar: لا تبخلوا إذا دُعيتم للإنفاق في سبيل الله
47:38:39.en: Do not be niggardly if you are asked to give in the cause of Allah

48:1:10.ar: فتح الله للمسلمين فتحًا مبينًا بصلح الحديبية ومبايعة النبي مبايعة لله
48:1:10.en: Allah granted the Muslims a manifest victory through the treaty of Hudeybiyah and Swearing allegiance to the Prophet is considered swearing allegiance to Allah

48:11:17.ar: الأعراب الذين تخلّفوا عن النبي في الحرب بين الإسلام والكفر مذمومون ولا حرج على الأعمى والأعرج والمريض
48:11:17.en: Beduin Arabs who did not go with the Prophet for war between Islam and Kufr are condemned for lagging behind and Only blind, lame and sick are exempt from war

48:18:26.ar: رضي الله عن الذين بايعوا النبي قبل صلح الحديبية ولولا رجال مؤمنون في مكة لأذن الله للمسلمين بقتال قريش
48:18:26.en: Allah was well pleased with those swore allegiance to the Prophet before the treaty of Hudeybiyah and  Had there not been believers in Makkah, Allah would have allowed the Muslims to fight against Qureysh
